title: Perimeter and area
examples: My garden is 12 m by 7.5 m, how much turf?
How much fence for a field 8 m by 5 m?
Area of a triangle with base 10 and height 6

explain.say: Perimeter is the distance all the way round the edge of a shape. Area is the surface inside it.
Perimeter is a length, so it uses plain units like metres. Area counts unit squares, so it uses square metres.
For a triangle, the area is half of the base times the height, because two copies of it make a rectangle.
The trap most students fall into: using the slanted side instead of the straight up height.

draw.text: Trap: use the perpendicular height, not the slanted side

faq: Perimeter is the distance all the way round the edge of a shape.
Area is the amount of surface inside a shape, counted in square units.

faq.q: Why is area in square units?
faq.a: Because area counts the unit squares that tile the shape.
asks: why do we write cm squared
why is it squared for area
what is the little 2 on cm
why is there a small 2 after m for area

faq.q: Do I use the slanted side for the area of a parallelogram?
faq.a: No. Use the perpendicular height, the straight up distance, not the slanted side.
asks: do i use the sloping side
which side do i use for a parallelogram

faq.q: Is perimeter the same as area?
faq.a: No. Perimeter is a length round the edge. Area is the surface inside.
asks: what is the difference between perimeter and area

faq.q: Why do we halve for a triangle?
faq.a: Two copies of a triangle make a parallelogram with area base times height, so one triangle is half of that.
asks: how come a triangle is half
why is a triangle half of a rectangle

faq: How do I find the area of a compound shape?
Split it into simple shapes, find each area, then add them, or subtract a missing part.
What is the area of a trapezium?
Add the two parallel sides, multiply by the height, then halve.

quiz.say: A garden bed is 8 metres by 5 metres. How much fence goes all the way round it?
quiz.show: A garden bed is 8 m by 5 m. How much fence goes round it?
quiz.why: Perimeter adds all four sides: two times 8 plus 5 is 26 metres.

wrong.0: That is the area number. Fence goes round the edge.
wrong.2: That is only two sides. There are four.
wrong.3: That is the area, and a fence is a length, not square metres.

quiz.say: A triangle has a base of 8 centimetres and a height of 5 centimetres. What is its area?
quiz.show: Base 8 cm, height 5 cm. What is the area?
quiz.why: Half of 8 times 5 is 20 square centimetres.

wrong.2: That adds the sides. Multiply, then halve.
wrong.3: That is a perimeter style sum, not an area.

quiz.say: A square has an area of 49 square centimetres. What is its perimeter?
quiz.show: A square has area 49 cm². What is its perimeter?
quiz.why: Each side is 7, because 7 times 7 is 49. Four sides of 7 make 28 centimetres.

wrong.0: That is one side. The perimeter has four.
wrong.1: That is the area number, not a length.
wrong.3: That multiplied 49 by 4. Find the side first.
